notes.title: EPIC UPDATE: NEW LANGUAGE AND QUEST ENHANCEMENTS!
notes.content:
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/wNHCjfMX/Captura-de-tela-2025-07-29-110843.png"]



This massive update introduces a new language to the realm - Spanish - to welcome even more brave souls to our medieval adventure. Furthermore, we've enriched the kingdom with new events and enhanced maps. We've also vanquished several minor bugs discovered during our questing trials.



The Spanish language has been conjured into the game, empowering players from Spanish-speaking realms to embark on their journey with greater ease, thus expanding our fellowship across more territories. 



This linguistic enchantment includes written dialogues, interface elements, voice acting (opening and ending cinematics), and in-game notifications. Soon, more tongues from distant lands shall be added to our arcane codex.



We have also summoned new events, dialogues, and legendary items to various regions of the map, while performing minor enchantments upon existing ones.



Finally, we've dispelled several minor curses within the game as they were discovered during our trials or reported by fellow adventurers from the realm.



May this update bring joy to your questing! We shall meet again in Sephadel! Until next time, brave adventurers!

notes.title: New features added in version 1.1
notes.content:
Hello, dear adventurers! Are you ready to embark on this epic journey in a completely revamped way?? Then check out what's new in the 1.1 update:

https://i.ibb.co/CKhYWqX1/Devlog.png

- Added a dynamic minimap  
Players will now have a minimap of the current area displayed on the game screen, showing their location as well as all important events on the map, such as enemies, chests, items, new quests, doors, etc.

- Speeding up vegetable harvesting when sleeping  
From now on, every time the player sleeps in their house at the Fortress, all crops will advance in their growth, bringing them closer to harvest.

- Changes to the game HUD  
Due to the addition of the minimap, several elements of the game's main HUD have been redesigned or repositioned on the screen to prevent conflicts or overlapping elements.

- Minor bug fixes  
During the update process and game improvements, some minor errors were found and properly fixed.

We hope you enjoy this update! We appreciate the players' feedback, and we'll see you in the next updates.

Best regards,  

DreamStories

notes.title: Enjoy Envyus on RPG Maker Festival 2025
notes.content:
[center]https://i.ibb.co/QMqNVSB/gif-jogo-exp2.gif[/center]

Are you ready to enjoy the RPG Maker Festival 2025 with this great game?

During the festival period, you will have an exclusive discount, so you can enjoy the game at a super affordable price.

In addition, you will be able to watch a live broadcast, which will give you an idea of ​​the features, gameplay, mechanics and a bit of the game's history, so you can learn even more about the game before playing it.

Several small updates and bug fixes will also be made available during the festival, making the game even more complete and attractive to everyone.

The event will take place from February 3rd to February 10th, 2025. We hope you enjoy the news.

Big hug.

Dream Stories Team.

notes.title: Navigation updates in some menus
notes.content:
Added the ability to navigate some menus using the keyboard. 

Previously, it was only possible using the mouse.

notes.title: Updates List
notes.content:
